stage.name: Big and Small
stage.description:
Different size, same determination.

<Danger Zone>Operators in the Danger Zone retreat at the end of the wave.

<Entitative Program>Available when retrying a wave that you have completed. Greatly strengthens your Operators for the wave.

originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_3.name: Originium Slug β
originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_3.flavourText: An infected wild creature that is more dangerous than an Originium Slug α. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.

arts_master_a1.name: Arts Master A1
arts_master_a1.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone with extremely high movement speed, modified from the product of an Arts Education competition. It is equipped with an Arts Weapon module that allows it to launch long-range Arts attacks, so proceed with caution. Based on available data, its weapon module also allows it to block some Arts damage.
abilities: Flying unit.

monster_mk_ii.name: Monster Mk II
monster_mk_ii.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone that has been upgraded from its namesake model, the Monster MkII. Equipped with a small gun and a long-range Arts receiver, they are likely operated by concealed Casters. Though unlikely to cause heavy damage to armored Operators, they can still pose a considerable threat.
abilities: Flying unit.

alcohol_association_member.name: Alcohol Association Member
alcohol_association_member.flavourText: A piss-drunk Durin. 'I'm not drunk! Who said I was drunk? Was it you?!'
abilities: Initially has 100% Physical Dodge for a period of time

sarkaz_blademaster.name: Sarkaz Blademaster
sarkaz_blademaster.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary, more skilled than an ordinary Sarkaz Swordsman. Though scarred by years of war, they are still fighting to fulfill the orders of their employers.

lakeside_lifeguard.name: Lakeside Lifeguard
lakeside_lifeguard.flavourText: A professional lifeguard who goes around shooting the breeze. Strong in stature and bronzed in complexion, one look at him is enough to give a sense of security. But in actuality, he can't swim at all, and got that tan from high-intensity outdoor boxing training.
abilities: Upon dropping below half HP for the first time, gains 100% Physical Dodge for a period of time

defender_4.name: Defender-4
defender_4.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone known as the Defender-4. Though they do not have any offensive capabilities, they must be taken care of due to their ability to support enemy troops.
abilities: Flying unit.
Increases the DEF of surrounding enemy units

shielded_soldier_leader.name: Shielded Soldier Leader
shielded_soldier_leader.flavourText: One of Reunion's melee soldiers, more dangerous than a normal Shielded Soldier. Equipped with illegally obtained weapons and armor, they additionally bear a shield. They are slightly harder to take down than a regular Reunion foot soldier.

sandcastle_architect.name: Sandcastle Architect
sandcastle_architect.flavourText: A Durin who has made a career out of designing sandcastles. Having accepted the reality that it is impossible to actually build a sandcastle, he has not even been drafting designs recently, instead focusing his efforts on tinkering with the Arts Unit.

sarkaz_bladeweaver_leader.name: Sarkaz Bladeweaver Leader
sarkaz_bladeweaver_leader.flavourText: An elite Sarkaz mercenary who has mastered the combination of swordsmanship and Arts. The Originium flowing through their blood allows them to hold these crudely modified Arts-imbued greatswords. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they are capable of dealing melee attacks that inflict Arts damage while in Combat-Ready mode.
abilities: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and inflicts Arts damage with melee attacks.

demolitionist_leader.name: Demolitionist Leader
demolitionist_leader.flavourText: A high-level elite Reunion combatant who wears heavy-duty, explosion-proof protective gear, more aggressive than normal Demolitionists. Their special Originium-powered hammers have massive destructive range, and must be dealt with cautiously.
abilities: Attacks cause an explosion, dealing Splash damage to units around the primary target.

senior_armed_militant.name: Senior Armed Militant
senior_armed_militant.flavourText: An enemy of unknown identity. Equipped with a complex array of armor, a gas mask, and tanks of unidentifiable substances, they attack using giant blunt instruments. Based on their equipment, they are even more dangerous than a normal Armed Militant. Though their movement is slow, even a single swing of their weapon is sure to inflict massive damage. Proceed with caution.

alloy_surfing_instructor.name: Alloy Surfing Instructor
alloy_surfing_instructor.flavourText: A sturdy mechanical surfing instructor that can withstand water and corrosion. High-density rare alloys were incorporated to increase its resistance to rust, but as such, it sinks even harder.
abilities: Can stop <Self-Driving Carts>
When not blocked, Physical and Arts damage taken is significantly reduced

arts_master_a2.name: Arts Master A2
arts_master_a2.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone that had some of its Flight Support modules swapped out, trading speed for a more powerful Arts Weapon module. Capable of using long-range Arts attacks. Proceed with caution. Based on available data, its weapon module also allows it to block some Arts damage.
abilities: Flying unit.

frost.name: Frost
frost.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone equipped with heavy armor to make it harder to destroy. Its prototype was designed by a graphics engine studio. They are equipped with a special device that allows them to drastically reduce the temperature around them, greatly decreasing the attack speed of nearby Operators.
abilities: Flying unit.
All friendly units within range have reduced ASPD

whiskey_grade_waker_upper.name: Whiskey-Grade Waker-Upper
whiskey_grade_waker_upper.flavourText: A terrifying machine that sweeps across the beach, equipped with an ultra-powerful water cannon strong enough to blast any drunkard to their senses. After someone secretly tampered with its targeting logic, it now only blasts sober people.
abilities: Upon taking damage for the first time, gains significantly increased ASPD and Movement Speed for a period of time

materialist_antagonizer.name: 'Materialist Antagonizer'
materialist_antagonizer.flavourText: Construction machinery attempting to protect Stitch Canvas, under the mistaken impression that he is about to be attacked. Before explaining what's actually going on, let's settle things with a test of strength first.
abilities: Initial Form
Aerial unit; unblockable
While on the battlefield, increases the strength of all Machine enemies
Attacks will deploy small drones that deal continuous Arts damage to the target for a period of time, prioritizing targets that are not already locked onto by these drones
Periodically refreshes a Barrier that can resist Physical and Arts damage. While the Barrier persists, other enemies within attack range gainsInvisibility.
Periodically locks on to the friendly unit with the greatest number of surrounding units and continuously deals Arts damage in an area around that unit
Periodically locks on to the friendly unit with the fewest number of units around it and continuously inflicts Stun in an area around that unit
When HP reaches 0 for the first time, Stitch will appear
Stitch Form
Stunned for a period of time after appearing on the field
Will not attack, and cannot be blocked

sarkaz_centurion.name: Sarkaz Centurion
sarkaz_centurion.flavourText: One of Reunion's squad leaders who also serves as a Sarkaz mercenary. He leads a group of Sarkaz mercenaries to fight on the front lines. Based upon the limited intel available, he is extremely tight-lipped, thus making it unlikely to get any information from him.
abilities: Attacks two targets simultaneously.

w.name: W
w.flavourText: A Sarkaz Mercenary and one of Reunion's squad leaders, she carries around a weapon that resembles a Laterano Gun. However, she almost exclusively attacks using explosives and throwing weapons. One of her common strategies is to attack the enemy's flank using large amounts of active Originium explosives. However, her erratic movements make her almost impossible to predict...
abilities: Can use explosives to deal heavy Physical damage to allied units
Uses more explosives when HP is under 50%
